newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Jackin shares debut at HK$2.325.
newsitem.headline: HK's Jackin shares debut at HK$2.325.

text.p: Shares of data storage products manufacturer Jackin International Holdings Ltd made their trading debut at HK$2.325 in Hong Kong, compared with their issue price of HK$1.05 per share.
The shares quickly jumped to HK$2.775 per share.
Jackin offered 90.75 million shares, involving 74.25 million new shares and 16.5 million existing shares, at HK$1.05 per share. Its initial public offering was about 257.9 times subscribed.
Jackin engages in manufacturing, replication and sale of content-based and blank information storage media products, including CD-ROMs, VCDs, CDs, CD cleaners and floppy disks.
